formTitle: DV-105 Request for Child Custody and Visitation Orders
_comment: Names outside the two seven-day charts are mapped by hand from the printed items. The charts are generated from page geometry: their AcroForm names (tf1, tf3, dropoff1, tf2, tf4, tf6 for Monday) carry no order, and only the widget rectangles say which column is Start and which is End. Fields left with their own id as newName are ones nothing has been decided about yet - they survive the sanitizer and print nothing.
